fact: Al-watwan, reporting the UNESCO RAM 2.0 readiness report presented in September 2026, says Comoros has no national strategy dedicated to artificial intelligence, and that drafting one is the first step still to be taken.

An Anaden official told Al-watwan there is no national AI policy, 'but we are thinking about it'; the digital strategy Comores Numerique 2028 only tracks reflections on future technology including AI.
